testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/pending-orders-validate-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account - Pending Orders > validate pending orders functionality

scenario.summary: The signed-in user opens Pending Orders, checks heading, filters and columns, pages through 8-row pages, checks the total, sorts by order number, status and amount, checks per-status filter counts, opens one pending order's details and its approver history, and checks that invalid searches in five filters return no records.
steps: Open Pending Orders: heading, filter options and column headers
Page size 8: footer '1 - 8 of <total>'; next page: '9 - <total> of <total>'
Page size 64: row count equals the footer total, which equals totalPendingOrders
Sort Order Number asc/desc: first-row anchors
Sort Pending Order Status asc/desc: first-row anchors
Sort Pending Order Amount asc/desc: monotonic (anchors only logged)
Filter status 'Pending Approval' then 'Approved': row counts
Open pending order PendingOrderNumber: heading, number, status, date
Invalid search text in five filters: 'No records found.'
stateChanges: None: pending orders are only read
assertions: Heading, filter options and column headers
Sort anchors for order number and status; amounts monotonic
Pending order details: heading, number, status PENDING APPROVAL, date; Approver History heading
evidence: Title 'validate pending orders functionality' matches the 10 steps; no linked AIO cases; data through loadData (spec line 32); username/password in the JSON are unused (not scanned, loginPage fixture unused)

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec runs in the webstore-auth project (playwright.testim-webstore.config.ts AUTH_SPECS = my-account/**) on the shared storageState written by testim-migrated/tests/auth.setup.ts, which signs in with getMyAccountUser() (src/data/credentials.ts) = loadEnvironment().myAccountUser, username from env var MY_ACCOUNT_USERNAME (src/config/env.ts:80, process.env / .env.<env>). The migrated test declares that same account at test start: await testData.useExisting('user', getMyAccountUser().username). The credential source points at that env var (no value stored). Caveat: all 20 webstore-auth specs share this one account; declaring it leases it per test, so tests that declare it run one at a time (leaseWaitMinutes 10) - reviewer to confirm that serialisation is wanted (it also prevents the template/order count collisions noted here)

OWNERSHIP + SHAPE: pending orders are ZnodeOrder rows of ClassCode ApprovalRoutings (numbers AR-...) visible to the signed-in account. Data shape: 9 to 64 pending orders (a second 8-row page must exist, all must fit a 64-row page), with at least one 'Pending Approval' and one 'Approved'

MISSING KEY: proposed PENDING_ORDER_OF_USER (entity order, ClassCode ApprovalRoutings): params owner (link @user.userId), store, status (optional), minPendingOrders, maxPendingOrders optional; outputs pendingOrderNumber, status, orderDate (MM/DD/YY), pendingCount, pendingApprovalCount, approvedCount. Reviewer to confirm whether the list shows the user's own submitted orders or the orders the user approves (Customer Name / Account Name filters suggest B2B account scope); the owner filter must follow that rule

Until then PendingOrderNumber, its status and date, the total and the status counts, and the sort anchors are recorded as expected-output only because a data source needs a declared alias; they are really account data. The sort anchors are first rows over all pending orders: proposal to keep monotonic checks and drop or derive the anchors
DATA IN CODE: spec line 122 asserts the literal 'AR-01102025-0068' (the same order as PendingOrderNumber): the migrated spec must use the resolved pending order number instead
migrate: owner-linked data, data in code, counts over many rows

Re-mapped to new keys (2026-11-01): pendingOrder = PENDING_ORDER_OF_USER (owner @user.userId as submitter, status pendingapproval since the opened order must show PENDING APPROVAL, minPendingOrders 9 so the 8-row default page has a second page, maxPendingOrders 64 = largePageSize, store): totalPendingOrders -> pendingCount, pendingApprovalCount -> pendingApprovalCount, approvedCount -> approvedCount, PendingOrderNumber and the literal receipt number (spec:122) -> pendingOrderNumber, pendingOrderStatus -> status, pendingOrderDate -> orderDate (status/orderDate from the key description, the pending_order entity map and the drafting proposal). The status filter counts need at least one Approved and one Pending Approval order: the key has no per-status minimum. LEFT AS expected-output: the sort anchors Ascending/Descending order number, status and amount (the key outputs no anchors); the two status anchors are also the filter values (fixed labels). Strategy migrate
